**CFA Institute** is a global not-for-profit organization for investment professionals, and it grants the **CFA®** designation.[3] It is based in **Charlottesville, Virginia**, and also has offices in **Hong Kong** and **London**.[1]

If by “cfa ins” you meant **CFA Institute**, that is the organization; if you meant something else, tell me and I’ll narrow it down.[1][3]
